purpose: Manifest of datasets from the research reports downloaded to local disk on this date; sizes, hashes and integrity checks recorded as evidence of obtained versions. Downloads only — no annotation audit, no model run.
local_root: datasets/ (gitignored; full per-file SHA-256 list in datasets/MANIFEST.json, not committed)

relocated_2026_11_12.method: rsync; all 6291 files re-verified byte-exact against MANIFEST.json before local deletion; archives then extracted on the drive (unzip CRC validates content)

extracted.mthv2: TKH/ (3,996 files) + MTH1200/ (4,800 files) from TKHMTH2200.zip
extracted.casia-ahcdb: style1_basic_test/ (5 gntx), style1_basic_train/ (20 gntx, book_01-20 assembled from the three part zips), style1_enhanced_train/ (20), style2_enhanced_train/ (244)

relocated_2026_11_12.archives_kept: Original zips retained next to extracted trees for provenance.

method: Hugging Face snapshots via huggingface_hub.snapshot_download; Google Drive via gdown (resume); Figshare and nlpr.ia.ac.cn via curl with resume and, where the server throttled a single stream, parallel HTTP range segments reassembled in order.

mthv2.integrity: unzip -t: no errors; 12811 entries (TKH/, MTH1200/, label_char/label_textline), 5062861976 bytes uncompressed
mthv2.note: Archive name and contents show it bundles TKH (1,000 pages) with MTH1200; the separately linked TKH/MTH Baidu netdisk packages were not downloaded. Non-commercial research license per author README.

ancientdoc.integrity: file count equals HF siblings metadata (3438); label.csv header matches 2026-11-11-ancientdoc-spotcheck.json (UTF-8-SIG)
ancientdoc.note: CC0-1.0 per dataset card. Prior spot-check caveats about label quality still apply.

chronicles-ocr.integrity: file count equals HF siblings metadata (2832); seven script directories (甲骨文/金文/篆书/隶书/草书/行书/楷书) plus data/ and eval/

casia-ahcdb.integrity: each zip passes unzip -t; sizes match server Content-Length exactly (two parts arrived truncated on first pass and were repaired via ranged resume to exact sizes)
casia-ahcdb.note: License/usage terms still not stated on the download page; CASIA-10k.zip (5.2G, modern handwriting) deliberately not downloaded as out of scope.

hisdoc1b.note: Figshare metadata says CC BY 4.0 while the author GitHub repo describes an application + password process under CC BY-NC-ND; license conflict recorded in the research report remains unresolved. Archive not extracted (disk space).
hisdoc1b.update_2026_11_12: Extraction attempt revealed the zip is fully password-encrypted (all 806 entries: books/ 401, annos/ 401, readme.md, read_anno.py, book2im.py). The archive is unusable without the password the authors send after institutional application; the CC BY 4.0 listing does not remove that gate. Encrypted zip retained on the external drive.

ancientdoc-ocr-mini.note: 11 PNG pages + gt.txt + notebook; serves as small-scale evaluation flow sample, not an independent gold set.

not_downloaded.tkh_mth: TKH/MTH Baidu-netdisk-only packages; CLI download not feasible. TKH portion is however included inside the MTHv2 archive TKHMTH2200.zip.
not_downloaded.scut_cab: Hugging Face archive exists (7.34 GB) but requires institutional application for the decompression password; encrypted download has no value without it.
not_downloaded.m5hisdoc: Application required; download link and password sent privately after approval.
not_downloaded.evahan2026: Data distributed after registration; only evaluation scripts are public.

limitations: Archives (MTHv2, CASIA, HisDoc1B) are kept unextracted to fit disk space; unzip -t was run instead of full extraction and content spot-checks.
SHA-256 values verify what is on local disk; upstream files can change.
Downloading does not equal license compliance: non-commercial / application-based terms recorded in resources.json still apply.
